counter: drone surveillance and fire control over pipeline exits
effect: exits held under fire; route almost fully under control within about two months, though sabotage groups still got through
rationale: Ukrainian drones watched the Kupiansk pipeline exits and held them under fire; the General Staff, the 10th Army Corps and Belskyi all reported the exit under Ukrainian control or fire control from 13 to 15 September 2025, and the route was 'almost fully under control' within a couple of months.

counter: exit kill zone: drone spotting plus artillery and bomber-drone strikes on emergences
effect: throughput cut to near zero: about 8 of 600 got through; about 95% of crossers killed or wounded
rationale: A drone spots an emergence and artillery or bomber drones saturate the hole; of about 600 Russians who tried in 100 days only eight got through, the 77th Airmobile Brigade caught about 40 near the Oskil, and Khartiia said in May 2026 that about 95% of crossers were killed or wounded within about 10 minutes of emerging.

counter: flooding the pipeline and filling holes with earth
effect: three of four pipelines damaged or flooded; the remaining line still usable
rationale: The 10th Army Corps said three of the four pipelines in the Kupiansk area were damaged or flooded, and Ukraine also filled exit holes with earth.

counter: drone, MLRS, airstrike and internal-charge attacks on the pipe
effect: temporary damage only; failed to destroy the pipe, leaving the hunting of shifting exits
